tasks.title: House to sword — 5-run checkout
tasks.x: Tap L2 at the house exit, the beach entry, the sword pickup, and any especially clean movement.
tasks.y: Tap R2 only after real damage, a wrong turn, a collision, or the recovery that follows it.
tasks.goal: Complete five natural runs from Marin's house to the sword. Use X immediately to discard a bad run; it reloads this same state.
